description: One metric's recent quarters read against the investment case: the claim it tests, whether it supports or challenges it, and what it cannot prove. item=earnings covers revenue, profit and EPS. Use when the user asks: what do X's earnings mean for the thesis. response_mode=plain for beginners. Not for: the full read → answer. Args: entity; item.

entity.description: The company: a ticker (AAPL, BRK.B), a company name (Apple) or an SEC CIK.
entity.title: Entity

item.description: The figure to read against the case: "earnings" (revenue, net income and diluted EPS together) or one metric: revenue, net_income, eps_diluted, gross_margin, operating_margin, net_margin, free_cash_flow, operating_cash_flow, ebitda, total_debt, cash, shares_outstanding.
item.title: Item

reading_level.description: With response_mode plain, who the explanation is written for: 5 a complete beginner, 10 a general reader, 13 an informed investor (unset reads as 13, with precise figures).
reading_level.title: Reading Level

response_mode.description: "standard" (default): the full read with the investment case; "plain": a short beginner-friendly explanation at the reading_level grade.
response_mode.title: Response Mode

name: get_thesis_impact
title: Thesis impact of an event
